rv.q: 'She Loves Me' is pure sterling. There's not a thing that's tired or overly tested here.
There is a sweetness and care to 'She Loves Me,' aided by Rockwell's glorious sets and Ellis' crisp direction.
If you want to leave the theatre walking on air in a perfume-scented cloud, 'She Loves Me' is your ticket.
Scott Ellis has polished this gem into a brilliant diamond and set it with an incredible cast.
'She Loves Me' reminds you that falling in love practically makes you want to do cartwheels.

cn.t: Critics celebrate this "non-stop delight" as a sparkling, intimate gem, praising Scott Ellis's polished direction, the enchanting chemistry between Laura Benanti and Zachary Levi, and the production's old-fashioned charm and sweetness.
